name: codebase
description: Rust MCP server that indexes Rust, Python, and TypeScript codebases into a LadybugDB property graph. Resolves imports and call chains, detects communities via the Leiden algorithm, traces execution flows from entry points. 23 MCP tools: index_codebase, query_graph, get_symbol, impact_analysis, semantic_diff, and more. BM25+TF-IDF+RRF hybrid search. 220 tests.
